onthisday.description: El 7 de abril de 1948 se establece la Organización Mundial de la Salud como organismo especializado de las Naciones Unidas, con el objetivo de alcanzar el máximo nivel de salud para todos los pueblos. Su creación marcó un hito en la coordinación internacional de políticas sanitarias.

news.headline: Anthropic signs a deal with Google and Broadcom for multiple GWs of TPU capacity, and says its run-rate revenue crossed $30B, up from ~$9B at the end of 2025
news.context: We have signed a new agreement with Google and Broadcom for multiple gigawatts of next-generation TPU capacity that we expect to come online starting in 2027.

news.headline: Sources: Meta has an internal leaderboard dubbed 'Claudeonomics' where employees compete on AI-token usage and earn rewards like 'Token Legend' status
news.context: Employees at Meta Platforms who want to show off their AI superuser chops are competing on an internal leaderboard for status as a token legend.

news.headline: Filing: Broadcom agrees to produce future versions of Google's TPUs and expands its Anthropic deal to give the startup access to ~3.5 GW of computing capacity
news.context: Broadcom said it agreed to produce future versions of Google's artificial intelligence chips, expanding access to computing capacity for Anthropic.

sciencedaily.headline: This Hidden State of Water Could Explain Why Life Exists
sciencedaily.summary: Scientists have finally found a hidden 'critical point' in supercooled water that explains why it behaves so strangely. At this point, two different liquid forms of water merge, triggering powerful fluctuations that affect water even at normal temperatures, which could help explain the unique properties that make life possible.

bigthink.headline: Why modern physics is forcing us to rethink existence
bigthink.relevance: Aborda cuestiones fundamentales sobre la naturaleza de la realidad y cómo los descubrimientos de la física cuántica desafían nuestra comprensión tradicional del universo.
